name: DeePMD-kit
description: Builds the hash-pinned DeePMD-kit 3.2.0 sdist (deep potential models; command dp and the ASE calculator deepmd.calculator.DP) into the environment of the python Feature with its PyTorch backend on the hash-locked PyTorch 2.13.0, and with the image's MPI when it has one. The cuda variant uses PyTorch for CUDA 12.6 and compiles DeePMD-kit's own CUDA kernels for one compute capability; PyTorch's CUDA run-time libraries add several gigabytes.

variant.description: cpu: PyTorch for CPUs. cuda: PyTorch for CUDA 12.6 and DeePMD-kit's CUDA kernels; requires the CUDA base image.

cudaArch.description: Compute capability DeePMD-kit's CUDA code of the cuda variant is compiled for (sm_<value>); PyTorch itself runs on every GPU its wheel supports.
